record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. What the executor was told and what it returned is the evidence behind a task, and collapsing keeps the detail scannable while the full text is one key away.

## Counter-argument

Showing only the latest report keeps the detail short, and the assignment text is the orchestrator's own words the user rarely needs.

payload.alternatives: full text of every assignment and report inline; only the latest execution report
payload.choice: The task detail shows the latest assignment, its amendments, and its execution report, each collapsed to 8 lines with Enter to expand and o for the pager; older assignments are listed by time
